answer: Sealed-bid lottery seats limit fake crowds: each epoch only 20 seats open, and every bid must lock 8 POA for 25 epochs, multiplied by 1.4 for each seat one funding source already holds. A atlas-small farm of ten fakes thus pays far more than the last, since one lagoon of identical bids shows a shared funder. Auditors replay the public ledger, and a harbor-heavy cluster loses its lock.
